name: Upper Middle Rhine Valley
description: This 65 km stretch of the Rhine between Koblenz and Rüdesheim runs through a steep slate gorge, with walls rising about 200 metres above the water. Around 40 hilltop castles, many of them ruins, look down on compact old towns and terraced vineyards. The famous Loreley rock and the area's many legends have inspired writers, painters and composers, and river cruises are a classic way to see it.
